summary_zh: 本页为《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》的封面，标题为《水塔抢修大行动》，展示了角色灰灰和小砾，背景为泳池场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这一天阳光明媚，灰灰和小砾正在冒险湾的公园里玩耍。
“天气太热了！”小砾说，“咱们去水池里玩吧！
但是来到水池边上时，他俩却惊奇地发现水池里一滴水都没有！
“天啊！这是怎么回事？”灰灰叫道。
“我也不知道，但是我们必须找到原因，这是汪汪队的工作。”小砾说，“开始行动吧！”，
page_text_en:
It was a sunny day, and Rocky and Rubble were playing in the park in Adventure Bay.
"It's so hot!" Rubble said, "Let's go play in the pool!"
But when they arrived at the pool, they were surprised to find that there was not a single drop of water in it!
"Oh no! What's going on?" Rocky cried.
"I don't know, but we must find out why. This is the Paw Patrol's job," Rubble said, "Let's get to work!"
summary_zh: 灰灰和小砾在冒险湾的公园里玩耍，想在水池里玩水，却发现水池干涸，于是决定调查原因并开始行动。

page_text_en:
At the tower,天天 and 毛毛 are packing up to go to the pool
and have a great day.
"Are you ready?"天天 asks.
毛毛 says: "Right away! Towel, sunscreen, sun hat, water,
and my Super Dog comic book, everything's ready, let's go!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了天天和毛毛在塔台准备去水池玩耍的场景，毛毛兴奋地展示她已准备好所有物品，包括浴巾、防晒霜、太阳帽、水和漫画书，准备出发。

page_text_en:
"No water? What should we do?" asked Alex.
"Don't worry, Alex!" said Ryder, pulling out his tablet. "The Paw Patrol will fix it!"
He pressed the emergency button to call the team to the Lookout.
Rocky and Rubble went to find the team for help. On Main Street, they ran into Ryder and Alex.
Ryder asked, "Pups, what's wrong?"
"There's no water in the pool!" Rocky said anxiously.
summary_zh: 灰灰和小砾在中央大街上遇到莱德和艾利克斯，告知水池没水的问题，莱德随即使用平板电脑按下紧急按钮，召集汪汪队成员前往塔台集合。

In a little while, the pups had assembled in formation at the Lookout.

Ryder said, “The water in the water tower can’t be delivered to the pool. We must find out why!

"Marshall, use your ladder to check the water tower. Rubble, get your digger ready — you might need to dig through a blocked pipe."

The pups excitedly received their orders.

"The rest of you, head to the pool and wait!" Ryder said.
summary_zh: 汪汪队成员在塔台集合完毕，莱德分析水塔无法供水的问题，并分配任务：毛毛检查水塔，小砾准备挖掘机疏通管道，其余成员前往水池待命。

莱德、小砾和毛毛来到了水塔，他们发现支撑水塔的柱子滑动了，导致水管弯曲变形。
莱德说：“在修好水管之前，我们得先把水塔修好。我们需要更多的队友来帮忙！”
莱德呼叫阿奇和灰灰：“阿奇，我们需要你的绞盘。灰灰，还有你的叉车！”
“没问题，马上到！”阿奇和灰灰回答。
page_text_en:
Ryder, Rubble, and Skye arrived at the water tower. They found that the support pillar had shifted, causing the water pipes to bend and deform.
Ryder said: "Before we fix the pipes, we need to repair the water tower first. We need more team members to help!"
Ryder called Chase and Rocky: "Chase, we need your winch. Rocky, and your forklift!"
"No problem, we're on our way!" Chase and Rocky replied.
summary_zh: 莱德、小砾和毛毛抵达水塔，发现支撑柱移位导致水管变形，莱德决定先修水塔并呼叫阿奇和灰灰支援，两人立即响应。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“阿奇，我们要用到你的缆绳钩和绞盘车。”
“包在我身上！”阿奇答道。
“毛毛，”莱德指示，“你能爬上水塔用钩子钩住水塔吗？”
“没问题！”毛比回答。

“好了，汪汪队员们，你们每个人都有重要的任务。”莱德说。
page_text_en:
"Chase, we're going to need your winch and cable hook."
"You can count on me!" Chase replied.
"Skye," Ryder instructed, "can you climb the water tower and hook onto it with your grappling hook?"
"No problem!" Skye answered.
When Chase and Rocky arrived at the water tower, all the team members were ready.
"Alright, Paw Patrol, everyone has an important job," Ryder said.
summary_zh: 阿奇和灰灰抵达水塔后，莱德分配任务，要求阿奇使用缆绳钩和绞盘车，毛毛爬上水塔用钩子固定，所有队员已准备就绪，即将开始抢修工作。

page_text_ocr_zh:
随后，小砾用他的挖掘机在靠近水塔的地方挖出了一堆土。

“干得好，小砾！”莱德说，“灰灰，现在用你的叉车将水泥柱抬起来，好让小砾把土推进去。”

“马上行动！”灰灰答道。
page_text_en:
Then, Rubble used his excavator to dig up a pile of dirt near the water tower.

"Well done, Rubble!" Ryder said. "Rocky, use your forklift to lift the concrete pillar so Rubble can push the dirt in."

"On it!" Rocky replied.
summary_zh: 小砾用挖掘机挖出一堆土，莱德指示灰灰用叉车抬起水泥柱，以便小砾将土推入，灰灰立即响应。

page_text_en:
Meanwhile, by the pool,天天 thought of a way to cool everyone down. She drove her helicopter toward a high mountain.
"Nothing is cooler than snow!"天天 thought.
Zuma said: "Wait,天天 will make us super cool!"
But all the snow that天天 dropped landed on Zuma.
"I was just a hot dog, now I'm an ice pop dog!" Zuma laughed.
summary_zh: 天天驾驶直升机去高山取雪，想让大家凉快，但撒下的雪全落在了路马身上，路马开心地自嘲成了“冰棒狗”。

“让水泥柱回到原位！”灰灰叫道。
等柱子重新立起来，阿奇松开绞盘，水塔恢复正常了！
“太棒了！”莱德说，“现在，让我们来修理弯曲的水管，好让水流重新通畅起来。”
page_text_en:
Over at the water tower, the team is doing the final repairs.
Chase uses the winch truck to hold the tower, Rocky lifts the concrete pillar, and Rubble fills the hole with dirt.
"Get the concrete pillar back in place!" Rocky shouts.
Once the pillar is upright again, Chase releases the winch, and the water tower is back to normal!
"Great job!" Ryder says, "Now, let's fix the bent pipes so the water can flow freely again."
summary_zh: 汪汪队成员在水塔处进行最后的修复工作，阿奇、灰灰和小砾分工合作，成功将移位的水泥柱复位，水塔恢复正常，莱德随即指示大家修理弯曲的水管。
